@media(max-width:640px){header nav{padding:12px 16px;gap:10px}header nav strong{font-size:20px}header nav>.btn,header .fixed-contact{display:none}header nav [data-pdf]{font-size:13px;padding:11px 13px}.back-top{right:16px;bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));padding:12px 16px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.back-top{transition:none}}

@media screen{body{padding-top:78px}header{display:block!important;position:fixed!important;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:9999!important}header nav{flex-wrap:nowrap}header nav [data-pdf]{display:inline-flex!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important}.back-top{display:flex!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important;z-index:9998;text-decoration:none}header nav>.btn{display:none}@media(max-width:640px){body{padding-top:70px}}}

.process-steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;align-items:stretch}.process-step{min-width:0;min-height:130px;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;text-align:left;padding:22px;border:1px solid #d8e4d6;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;outline:none;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}.process-step strong{font-size:18px;line-height:1.3;margin:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.process-step small{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;margin-top:9px}.process-step.active{background:#eaf3e6;border-color:#39835e;box-shadow:inset 4px 0 #17674e}.process-step:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #d7b368;outline-offset:3px}.process-detail{min-height:230px;margin-top:20px}.process-detail strong{font-size:24px;max-width:900px}.process-detail p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;max-width:960px}.explorer>*{min-width:0}.result-route>*{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}iframe{max-width:100%}
@media(max-width:760px){.process-steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.process-step{padding:17px;min-height:135px}.process-step strong{font-size:16px}.process-step small{font-size:12px}.process-detail{min-height:290px;padding:22px}.process-detail strong{font-size:21px}.process-detail p{font-size:15px}}
@media(max-width:420px){.process-steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}.process-step{min-height:95px}.process-detail{min-height:340px}}

#process-toggle{display:none!important}

#process-demo .eyebrow{margin-bottom:16px}.static-journey{max-width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.journey-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(200px,.85fr) minmax(0,2fr);gap:30px;align-items:center;padding:24px 28px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d8e4d6;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 3px 12px #173e3105}.journey-card h3{font-size:20px;line-height:1.35;color:#17674e}.journey-card p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.65;color:#52675f}.journey-arrow{height:34px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:28px;color:#39835e}.journey-card:last-child{background:#eaf3e6;border-color:#b6d0b6}#process-demo,#process-demo *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
@media(max-width:640px){.journey-card{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px;padding:20px}.journey-card h3{font-size:18px}.journey-card p{font-size:14px}}

#process-demo .wrap{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;visibility:visible!important}#process-demo *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}#process-demo .journey-arrow{display:flex!important;opacity:1!important;visibility:visible!important}

.tile-journey{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:48px 44px;align-items:start}.journey-tile{position:relative;background:#fff;border:1px solid #c8dcca;border-radius:16px;min-width:0}.journey-tile summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;min-height:120px;padding:25px 45px 25px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4;color:#17674e;position:relative}.journey-tile summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.journey-tile[open]{background:#eaf3e6;border-color:#39835e}.journey-tile p{padding:0 24px 24px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.65;color:#52675f}.journey-tile summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #d7b368;outline-offset:3px;border-radius:16px}.journey-tile::after{position:absolute;display:block;color:#17674e;font-size:32px;line-height:1;pointer-events:none}.journey-tile:nth-child(1)::after,.journey-tile:nth-child(2)::after{content:"→";top:44px;right:-36px}.journey-tile:nth-child(3)::after{content:"↓";bottom:-40px;left:calc(50% - 12px)}.journey-tile:nth-child(4){grid-column:3;grid-row:2}.journey-tile:nth-child(5){grid-column:2;grid-row:2}.journey-tile:nth-child(6){grid-column:1;grid-row:2}.journey-tile:nth-child(4)::after,.journey-tile:nth-child(5)::after{content:"←";top:44px;left:-36px}
@media(max-width:640px){.tile-journey{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}.journey-tile:nth-child(n){grid-column:auto;grid-row:auto}.journey-tile:not(:last-child)::after{content:"↓";top:auto;right:auto;bottom:-35px;left:calc(50% - 12px)}.journey-tile summary{min-height:95px;font-size:17px}}

button.journey-tile{font:inherit;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;min-height:120px;padding:24px;color:#17674e;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center}button.journey-tile[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#eaf3e6;border-color:#39835e;box-shadow:inset 4px 0 #17674e}button.journey-tile:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #d7b368;outline-offset:3px}.journey-description{margin-top:28px;border-radius:16px;background:#eaf3e6;border:1px solid #c8dcca;padding:28px 30px}.journey-description h3{font-size:23px;color:#17674e;margin-bottom:12px}.journey-description p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.7;color:#52675f;max-width:950px}.journey-description[hidden]{display:none}@media(max-width:640px){button.journey-tile{min-height:95px;font-size:17px}.journey-description{padding:22px}.journey-description h3{font-size:20px}}

.hero-lead{max-width:720px;margin:18px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:18px;line-height:1.6}
.section-lead{max-width:880px;margin:14px 0 24px;color:var(--muted);font-size:18px;line-height:1.6}
.audience-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;margin:24px 0 24px}
.audience-grid article{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.96),rgba(248,250,252,.96));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;padding:26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.chip-cloud{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:18px 0}
.chip-cloud .chip{background:rgba(20,82,59,.08);color:var(--green-700);border:1px solid rgba(20,82,59,.15)}
.photo-duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px;margin:10px 0 28px}
.photo-card{margin:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.photo-card img{display:block;width:100%;height:320px;object-fit:cover;background:#eef2f7}
.photo-card figcaption{padding:18px 20px 22px;display:grid;gap:8px}
.photo-card figcaption strong{font-size:20px;color:var(--ink)}
.photo-card figcaption span{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6}
@media (max-width:900px){.audience-grid,.photo-duo{grid-template-columns:1fr}.photo-card img{height:260px}}

body{background:#fffaf3!important;color:#263a31!important;font-family:Arial,sans-serif!important}header{background:rgba(255,250,243,.96)!important;border-bottom:1px solid #eddfd1!important}.personal-banner{background:#fff3dc!important}.video-section.hero-video{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#fff8eb,#f2f8e9)!important}#video .hero-title{letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.08}.hero-lead{font-size:19px;color:#516457!important;line-height:1.65}section h2{letter-spacing:-.025em}.photo-intro{font-size:19px;line-height:1.55;color:#486456;margin:12px 0 22px}.photo-card{border-color:#ecddc9!important;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(73,49,28,.09)!important}.photo-card img{filter:saturate(.86) contrast(.98)}.audience-grid article{border-color:#eadfcb!important;background:#fffdf7!important}.chip-cloud .chip{border-radius:100px!important;background:#f5f5e9!important}#video .video-shell{border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden}@media(max-width:720px){.hero-lead,.photo-intro{font-size:16px}}

.visual-story{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;align-items:center;gap:0;margin:38px 0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #eddfd2;border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(64,53,32,.1)}
.visual-story-media{height:100%;min-height:355px;overflow:hidden;background:#edf2e8}.visual-story-media img{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:355px;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.visual-story-content{padding:clamp(23px,3.5vw,48px)}.visual-story-content h3{font-size:clamp(23px,2.25vw,33px);line-height:1.2;margin:12px 0 14px;color:#183f32}.visual-story-content p{line-height:1.7;color:#536458;font-size:17px}.story-kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#24754c}.story-pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:24px}.story-pills span{background:#eaf3e6;color:#275e3f;border-radius:999px;padding:9px 13px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}.story-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:20px;font-weight:800;color:#17744e}.staff-story{grid-template-columns:.95fr 1.05fr}.staff-story .visual-story-media{order:2}.staff-story .visual-story-content{order:1}
@media(max-width:800px){.visual-story,.staff-story{grid-template-columns:1fr}.visual-story-media,.staff-story .visual-story-media{order:0;min-height:220px}.visual-story-media img{min-height:220px;max-height:330px}.staff-story .visual-story-content{order:1}.visual-story-content{padding:24px}.visual-story-content p{font-size:15px}}

/* WOW PATCH */
.case .audience-grid article,.case .audience-grid article *{color:#1f372d!important}
.case .audience-grid article p,.case .audience-grid article .note{color:#516457!important}
.case .mini-label{color:#8fb39d!important}
.case .audience-grid h3{color:#16382c!important}
.case .chip-cloud .chip{background:#f4f5ea!important;color:#244936!important;border-color:#d9e1cf!important}
.case .note,.case .case-result{color:#dceadf!important}
.case .case-result strong{color:#fff!important}
.case .case-details h3{color:#fff!important}
.case .case-details p{color:#d8e7dd!important}
.scenario-showcase{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr;gap:22px;align-items:stretch;margin:24px 0 30px}
.scenario-copy{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffef9,#f7f8ee);border:1px solid #e5dcc8;border-radius:24px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 10px 25px rgba(73,49,28,.08)}
.scenario-copy h3{font-size:32px;line-height:1.18;color:#20372d;margin:10px 0 16px}.scenario-copy p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.65;color:#5a6f61}
.switch-photo-card{margin:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5dcc8;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(73,49,28,.10);display:grid}
.switch-photo-card img{display:block;width:100%;height:360px;object-fit:cover;background:#eef2f7}.switch-photo-card figcaption{padding:16px 18px 20px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;color:#516457}
#explore .explorer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(300px,.92fr) minmax(320px,1.08fr) minmax(320px,1fr);gap:18px;align-items:stretch}
.task-visual-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5dcc8;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(73,49,28,.09);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.task-visual-card img{width:100%;height:100%;max-height:430px;min-height:320px;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:#eef2f7}.task-visual-copy{padding:16px 18px 20px;display:grid;gap:8px}.task-visual-copy strong{font-size:20px;color:#22392f}.task-visual-copy span{font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;color:#5a6f61}
#explore .task-result{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#eff4e9,#edf3e9);border:1px solid #dbe8d8}#explore .task-result h3{color:#20372d}#explore .task-result p{color:#42594e}
.tabs{margin-bottom:16px}.tabs button{transition:.25s ease;border:1px solid #dbe3d0;background:#fff;color:#244936}.tabs button[aria-selected="true"]{background:#e9f2e7;border-color:#17674e;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(23,103,78,.08)}.panel .flow{margin-bottom:16px}.panel .note{font-size:15px;color:#667d6d}
.photo-card,.switch-photo-card,.task-visual-card{transition:transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease}.photo-card:hover,.switch-photo-card:hover,.task-visual-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 18px 34px rgba(73,49,28,.12)}
@media (max-width:1020px){.scenario-showcase{grid-template-columns:1fr}#explore .explorer{grid-template-columns:1fr}.switch-photo-card img,.task-visual-card img{height:320px;max-height:none}}


/* Final contrast and accessibility correction. Scope by surface, not entire section. */
#case.case .audience-grid > article {background:#fffdf7!important;border:1px solid #d3dece!important;}
#case.case .audience-grid > article h3,
#case.case .audience-grid > article strong,
#case.case .audience-grid > article .mini-label {color:#17382b!important; opacity:1!important; -webkit-text-fill-color:#17382b!important;}
#case.case .audience-grid > article p,
#case.case .audience-grid > article .note {color:#445b4e!important;opacity:1!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#445b4e!important;}
#case.case .audience-grid > article .chip-cloud .chip {color:#244936!important; background:#edf2e8!important;border:1px solid #cad8c9!important;opacity:1!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#244936!important;}
#case.case .audience-grid > article * {text-shadow:none!important;}
#scenarios .scenario-copy h3,#explore .task-result h3 {color:#183a2a!important;opacity:1!important}
#scenarios .scenario-copy p,#explore .task-result p {color:#3d5645!important;opacity:1!important}
#case .photo-card figcaption strong,#case .photo-card figcaption span{color:#203e2d!important;opacity:1!important}
#explore .task-visual-copy strong{color:#203e2d!important}#explore .task-visual-copy span{color:#425b4e!important}
#scenarios .switch-photo-card img,#explore .task-visual-card img{object-position:center center}
@media (max-width:1050px){#explore .explorer{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important}#explore .task-visual-card{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}#explore .task-visual-card img{min-height:270px;max-height:330px;height:100%;}}
@media (max-width:700px){#explore .explorer{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}#explore .task-visual-card{display:block;grid-column:auto}#explore .task-visual-card img{height:270px;min-height:0}#case .audience-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}


/* === REVIEW FIXES === */
.brand-home{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0;padding:12px 18px;min-width:188px;min-height:86px;border:1px solid #d9e2d6;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;color:#22392f;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(28,46,38,.08)}
.brand-home img{width:auto;height:62px;max-width:100%;display:block;object-fit:contain}
.brand-home span{display:none!important}.brand-home strong{font-size:15px;color:#22392f}.brand-home small{font-size:12px;color:#5f7567}
header nav>strong{display:none!important}.personal-banner{display:none!important}
.wrap{max-width:1200px}
section{padding-top:72px;padding-bottom:72px}
.hero-lead,.section-lead,.case-lead,.camp-ops-lead{max-width:920px;font-size:18px;line-height:1.65;color:#566c5f}

/* scenarios tabs / general contrast */
.tabs button,.camp-fit-btn,.calc-chip{color:#204032!important;background:#fff!important;border:1px solid #cfdccc!important}
.tabs button[aria-selected="true"],.camp-fit-btn.active,.calc-chip.active{background:#196b4f!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#196b4f!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.tabs button[aria-selected="true"] *, .camp-fit-btn.active *{color:#fff!important}
.panel .note,.task span,.result-proof{color:#647a6d!important}
.task.active{background:#e9f3ea!important;border-color:#196b4f!important;color:#204032!important;box-shadow:inset 4px 0 #196b4f}
.task.active strong,.task.active span{color:#204032!important}

/* case camp-fit section */
.case{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f3c2f 0%,#2e6c49 100%)!important}
.case .eyebrow,.case h2,.case .case-lead{color:#fff!important}
.camp-fit-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px 1.05fr .95fr;gap:20px;align-items:stretch;margin-top:24px}
.camp-fit-tabs{display:grid;gap:12px;align-content:start}
.camp-fit-btn{padding:16px 18px;border-radius:16px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.35;text-align:left;transition:.2s ease;cursor:pointer}
.camp-fit-info,.camp-fit-photo{background:#fffdf8;border-radius:26px;border:1px solid rgba(223,233,223,.7);padding:28px;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.camp-fit-info .mini-label{color:#6e8d7b!important;letter-spacing:1.4px;font-size:11px}
.camp-fit-info h3{font-size:34px;line-height:1.18;margin:10px 0 16px;color:#1c3a2e}
.camp-fit-info p,.camp-fit-info li,.camp-fit-foot{color:#4f6659;font-size:17px;line-height:1.6}
.camp-fit-list{margin:0;padding-left:20px;display:grid;gap:10px}
.camp-fit-foot{margin-top:16px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #dfe8dd}
.camp-fit-photo{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:0;overflow:hidden}
.camp-fit-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:420px;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.camp-fit-photo figcaption{padding:16px 18px 20px;color:#4f6659;font-size:15px;line-height:1.55}

/* explore */
#explore .explorer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,.86fr) minmax(320px,1fr) minmax(320px,.95fr)!important;gap:18px;align-items:stretch}
#explore .task-result{background:#eef4ec!important;border:1px solid #d7e3d4}.task-visual-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dfe7db;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(36,57,47,.08)}
.task-visual-card img{width:100%;height:350px;object-fit:cover;display:block}.task-visual-copy{padding:16px 18px 20px}.task-visual-copy strong{display:block;font-size:20px;color:#1e3a30;margin-bottom:8px}.task-visual-copy span{color:#597063;line-height:1.6}

/* camp ops unique block */
.camp-ops-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:22px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:24px}.camp-ops-photo{margin:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dfe7db;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(36,57,47,.07)}
.camp-ops-photo img{width:100%;height:340px;object-fit:cover;display:block}.camp-ops-photo figcaption{padding:14px 16px 18px;color:#5c7367;font-size:15px}
.camp-ops-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px}.camp-ops-card{background:#eef4ec;border:1px solid #dbe5d9;border-radius:24px;padding:28px}.camp-ops-card h3{font-size:28px;line-height:1.25;color:#1c3a2e;margin:8px 0 14px}.camp-ops-card ul{margin:0 0 16px;padding-left:20px;display:grid;gap:10px}.camp-ops-card li,.camp-ops-card p{color:#52685c;line-height:1.65;font-size:16px}

/* terms */
.terms-modern{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.05fr;gap:28px;align-items:center}.terms-highlights{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}.terms-highlights span{background:#eef4ec;border:1px solid #d6e3d4;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 14px;color:#244936;font-size:14px}
.auditor-calc{background:#eef4ec;border:1px solid #d7e3d4;border-radius:26px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(36,57,47,.06)}.calc-presets{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}.calc-chip{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer}.auditor-calc label{display:block;font-size:14px;color:#5b7164;margin-bottom:8px}.auditor-calc input[type=number]{width:100%;padding:16px 18px;border:1px solid #cad8ca;border-radius:12px;font-size:20px;background:#fff;color:#1f382f}.auditor-calc input[type=range]{width:100%;margin:18px 0 8px}.calc-results{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:12px}.calc-results div{background:#fff;border:1px solid #d9e4d9;border-radius:18px;padding:18px}.calc-results span{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#62786b;margin-bottom:8px}.calc-results strong{font-size:38px;line-height:1.1;color:#1d3a2f}.calc-note{margin-top:16px;color:#5c7266;line-height:1.6;font-size:14px}

/* contact */
.contact-modern{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.95fr 1.05fr;gap:24px;align-items:stretch}.manager-card,.contact-cta-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dfe7db;border-radius:26px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(36,57,47,.07)}.manager-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px 1fr;gap:22px;align-items:center}.manager-photo{width:220px;height:290px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:20px;display:block;background:#eaeaea}.manager-info h3{font-size:30px;line-height:1.2;color:#1f3a30;margin:8px 0 12px}.manager-info p,.contact-cta-card p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.7;color:#566c5f}.manager-links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-top:16px}.manager-links a{color:#1d6b50;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700}.contact-cta-card h2{font-size:42px;line-height:1.12;color:#1f3a30;margin:6px 0 16px}.cta-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:22px}

/* generic readability */
.mini-label{font-weight:700}
.final,.contact .wrap,.case .audience-grid article{color:#1f372d}
.case .note,.case .case-result,.case .case-details p,.case .case-details h3{color:inherit}

@media(max-width:1100px){.camp-fit-grid,.camp-ops-hero,.terms-modern,.contact-modern{grid-template-columns:1fr}.camp-fit-photo img{min-height:300px}.manager-card{grid-template-columns:1fr}.manager-photo{width:100%;max-width:260px;height:auto}.camp-ops-grid,.calc-results{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:900px){#explore .explorer{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.camp-fit-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.camp-fit-tabs{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.camp-fit-btn{font-size:15px}.contact-cta-card h2{font-size:32px}}
@media(max-width:640px){.brand-home small{display:none}.camp-fit-tabs{grid-template-columns:1fr}.calc-results strong{font-size:30px}.manager-card,.contact-cta-card,.camp-fit-info,.camp-fit-photo,.auditor-calc,.camp-ops-card{padding:22px}.camp-fit-photo{padding:0}}


/* === refinement round === */
:root{--wrap-max:1320px}
.wrap{max-width:var(--wrap-max)}
header nav{gap:16px}
.brand-home{padding:10px 16px;min-width:126px;justify-content:center}
.brand-home img{height:28px;width:auto;display:block}
.brand-home span,.brand-home strong,.brand-home small{display:none!important}
header nav .navlink{font-size:15px}
header nav .btn{margin-left:auto}

/* scenarios images */
#scenarios .visual-story{grid-template-columns:1.08fr .92fr;gap:20px;align-items:stretch}
#scenarios .visual-story-media img{min-height:320px;object-fit:cover}
#scenarios .scenario-showcase{grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:20px}
#scenarios .switch-photo-card img{height:420px}
#scenarios .scenario-copy,#scenarios .switch-photo-card{height:100%}

/* case */
.case .camp-fit-grid.swapped{display:grid;grid-template-columns:250px .95fr 1.05fr;gap:20px;align-items:stretch}
.camp-fit-photo.large-photo img{height:100%;min-height:520px;object-fit:cover}
.camp-fit-photo.large-photo,.camp-fit-info.large-copy{height:100%}
.camp-fit-info.large-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.camp-fit-info.large-copy h3{font-size:56px;line-height:1.06;max-width:500px}
.camp-fit-info.large-copy p,.camp-fit-info.large-copy li,.camp-fit-foot{font-size:18px;line-height:1.6}
.camp-fit-list{gap:12px;margin-top:8px}
.camp-fit-foot{margin-top:auto}

/* explore larger */
#explore .explorer{grid-template-columns:340px 1.2fr 1.02fr!important;gap:18px}
#explore .task-options{display:grid;gap:14px}
#explore .task{padding:22px 20px;min-height:96px}
#explore .task-result{padding:40px 34px;min-height:540px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
#explore .task-result h3{font-size:58px;line-height:1.05;max-width:520px}
#explore .task-result p{font-size:19px;line-height:1.7;max-width:560px}
#explore .result-route{margin:24px 0 28px;gap:16px}.result-route span{padding:16px 20px;font-size:17px}
#explore .result-proof{margin-top:28px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6}
#explore .task-visual-card{min-height:540px}.task-visual-card img{height:390px}.task-visual-copy{padding:24px 22px 26px}.task-visual-copy strong{font-size:26px}.task-visual-copy span{font-size:18px}

/* camp ops */
.camp-ops-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px}.camp-ops-photo img{height:420px}.camp-ops-lead{font-size:19px}
.camp-ops-card h3{font-size:32px}

/* pricing simple */
.pricing-simple{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:34px;align-items:center}
.pricing-copy h2{font-size:60px;line-height:1.04;max-width:620px}
.pricing-copy p{font-size:20px;line-height:1.7;max-width:640px}
.pricing-badges{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:20px}.pricing-badges span{background:#eef4ec;border:1px solid #d7e3d4;border-radius:999px;padding:13px 18px;color:#244936;font-size:15px}
.classic-calc{background:#eef4ec;border:1px solid #d7e3d4;border-radius:28px;padding:32px;box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(36,57,47,.06)}
.classic-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;margin-bottom:22px}.classic-percent{font-size:96px;line-height:.9;font-weight:800;color:#1d3a2f}.classic-desc{font-size:24px;line-height:1.25;color:#486154;max-width:260px}
.classic-calc label{display:block;font-size:15px;color:#5a7265;margin-bottom:10px}.classic-presets{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}.calc-chip{padding:12px 16px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #cfdccc;background:#fff;color:#204032;cursor:pointer}.calc-chip.active{background:#196b4f;color:#fff;border-color:#196b4f}
.classic-calc input[type=number]{width:100%;padding:18px 20px;border:1px solid #cad8ca;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;color:#1f382f;font-size:30px;font-weight:700}
.classic-result-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:18px}.classic-box{background:#fff;border:1px solid #d9e4d9;border-radius:20px;padding:22px}.classic-box.light{background:#f8fbf8}.classic-box span{display:block;color:#5f7568;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px}.classic-box strong{font-size:42px;color:#1e3a30;line-height:1.1}
.calc-note{margin-top:16px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.65;color:#5c7266}

/* mobile */
@media(max-width:1200px){.camp-fit-info.large-copy h3{font-size:46px}#explore .task-result h3{font-size:46px}.pricing-copy h2{font-size:48px}}
@media(max-width:1024px){header nav .btn{margin-left:0}.case .camp-fit-grid.swapped,.pricing-simple,.camp-ops-hero,#scenarios .visual-story,#scenarios .scenario-showcase{grid-template-columns:1fr}.camp-fit-photo.large-photo img{min-height:340px}#explore .explorer{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.task-visual-card img{height:320px}.camp-ops-photo img{height:320px}.camp-fit-info.large-copy h3,#explore .task-result h3,.pricing-copy h2{font-size:40px}}
@media(max-width:720px){.brand-home{min-width:0;padding:8px 14px}header nav{gap:12px}.navlink{display:none}.case .camp-fit-grid.swapped{grid-template-columns:1fr}.camp-fit-tabs{grid-template-columns:1fr}.camp-fit-info.large-copy h3,#explore .task-result h3,.pricing-copy h2{font-size:32px}.pricing-copy p,#explore .task-result p,.task-visual-copy span,.camp-fit-info.large-copy p,.camp-fit-info.large-copy li{font-size:16px}.classic-head{display:block}.classic-percent{font-size:76px}.classic-desc{font-size:20px;max-width:none}.classic-result-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}}


/* === v3 fixes: real logo, swap dynamic block, less photo crop === */
.brand-home{padding:12px 18px!important;min-width:188px!important;min-height:86px!important;background:#fff!important;border-radius:20px!important}
.brand-home img{height:62px!important;width:auto!important;max-width:100%!important;display:block!important;object-fit:contain!important}

#scenarios .primary-showcase{margin-top:24px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.08fr .92fr;gap:22px;align-items:stretch}
#scenarios .secondary-story{margin-top:22px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.08fr .92fr;gap:22px;align-items:stretch}
#scenarios .scenario-copy,#scenarios .switch-photo-card,#scenarios .visual-story-copy,#scenarios .visual-story-media{height:100%}
#scenarios .switch-photo-card img,#scenarios .visual-story-media img{width:100%;height:auto!important;max-height:560px;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center center!important;background:#f4f4ef}
#scenarios .switch-photo-card{padding:0;overflow:hidden}
#scenarios .visual-story-media{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dfe7db;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden}
#scenarios .visual-story-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
#scenarios .scenario-copy h3,#scenarios .visual-story-copy h3{font-size:42px;line-height:1.1}
#scenarios .scenario-copy p,#scenarios .visual-story-copy p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.65}

.case .camp-fit-grid.swapped{grid-template-columns:230px .92fr 1.08fr!important;align-items:start!important}
.camp-fit-photo.large-photo{align-self:start;background:#fffdf8}
.camp-fit-photo.large-photo img{width:100%;height:auto!important;max-height:700px;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center top!important;background:#f7f7f2}
.camp-fit-info.large-copy h3{font-size:48px!important;line-height:1.08!important}
.camp-fit-info.large-copy{min-height:0!important}

#explore .explorer{grid-template-columns:320px 1.15fr 1fr!important;align-items:start!important}
#explore .task-result{min-height:0!important}
#explore .task-visual-card{min-height:0!important;align-self:start}
#explore .task-visual-card img{width:100%;height:auto!important;max-height:520px;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center center!important;background:#eef4ec}
#explore .task-visual-copy strong{font-size:24px!important}
#explore .task-result h3{font-size:46px!important;line-height:1.08!important}

.camp-ops-photo img{width:100%;height:auto!important;max-height:460px;object-fit:contain!important;background:#f7f7f2}

@media(max-width:1024px){
  #scenarios .primary-showcase,#scenarios .secondary-story{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
  .case .camp-fit-grid.swapped{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
  #explore .explorer{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
  #scenarios .switch-photo-card img,#scenarios .visual-story-media img,.camp-fit-photo.large-photo img,#explore .task-visual-card img,.camp-ops-photo img{max-height:none!important}
}

/* Two-field CampBox commission calculator */
#terms .calc-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:24px}
#terms .calc-fields label{display:block;color:#3d5b4d;font-size:15px;font-weight:650;margin-bottom:10px}
#terms .calc-fields input{width:100%;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box;background:white;color:#17392c;border:1px solid #b9cfbe;border-radius:13px;padding:17px 14px;font-size:23px;font-weight:700;outline-offset:3px}
#terms .calc-output{display:grid;gap:12px}
#terms .calc-output-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:baseline;border-bottom:1px solid #d0dfd2;padding:12px 0;color:#476254}
#terms .calc-output-line strong{font-size:23px;color:#163b2c;white-space:nowrap}
#terms .calc-final{background:#176a4e;color:white;border-radius:18px;padding:22px;display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
#terms .calc-final span{font-size:16px;color:white}
#terms .calc-final strong{font-size:42px;line-height:1.05;color:white}
#terms .calc-vat-notice{display:inline-block;margin-top:24px;padding:11px 16px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #d1a25f;background:#fff0d8;color:#72440e;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em}
#terms .calc-vat-notice.small{margin-top:16px;font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:720px){#terms .calc-fields{grid-template-columns:1fr}#terms .calc-final strong{font-size:32px}#terms .calc-output-line strong{font-size:20px}}


/* v5: cohesive horizontal rhythm and no empty photo gutters */
#case .camp-fit-grid.swapped{grid-template-columns:220px minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:20px!important;align-items:stretch!important}

#case .camp-fit-photo.large-photo img{flex:1 1 auto!important;width:100%!important;height:0!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important;object-fit:cover!important;object-position:center 42%!important;display:block!important}
#case .camp-fit-photo.large-photo figcaption{flex:0 0 auto!important;max-width:none!important;background:#fffdf8!important;padding:16px 20px!important;font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.5!important}
#case .camp-fit-info.large-copy{height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;padding:27px 28px!important;justify-content:center!important}
#case .camp-fit-info.large-copy h3{font-size:clamp(25px,2.4vw,34px)!important;line-height:1.18!important;margin:8px 0 14px!important;letter-spacing:-.02em!important}
#case .camp-fit-info.large-copy p,#case .camp-fit-info.large-copy li,#case .camp-fit-foot{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.55!important}

#case .camp-fit-foot{margin-top:14px!important;padding-top:12px!important}
#case .camp-fit-tabs{gap:10px!important}
#case .camp-fit-btn{padding:15px 16px!important}

#explore .explorer{grid-template-columns:300px minmax(0,1.1fr) minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:18px!important;align-items:stretch!important}
#explore .task-result{min-height:0!important;height:auto!important;padding:30px 28px!important;justify-content:center!important}
#explore .task-result h3{font-size:clamp(25px,2.55vw,35px)!important;line-height:1.18!important;letter-spacing:-.02em!important;margin:10px 0 20px!important}
#explore .task-result p{font-size:16px!important;line-height:1.58!important}
#explore .task-visual-card{height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;align-self:stretch!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;overflow:hidden!important}
#explore .task-visual-card img{width:100%!important;flex:1 1 auto!important;height:0!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important;object-fit:cover!important;object-position:center 42%!important}
#explore .task-visual-copy{flex:0 0 auto!important;padding:17px 20px 20px!important}
#explore .task-visual-copy strong{font-size:20px!important;line-height:1.2!important}
#explore .task-visual-copy span{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.5!important}
#explore .result-proof{font-size:14px!important;margin-top:20px!important;padding-top:12px!important}
#explore .result-route span{font-size:14px!important;padding:13px!important}
#explore .task{min-height:0!important;padding:17px!important}
#explore .task-options{gap:10px!important}

#terms .pricing-copy h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.1vw,43px)!important;line-height:1.12!important;max-width:600px!important}
#terms .pricing-copy p{font-size:17px!important;line-height:1.6!important}
#terms .calc-vat-notice.small{display:block!important;color:#697a70!important;background:none!important;border:0!important;padding:0!important;margin:12px 0 0!important;font-weight:400!important;letter-spacing:0!important;text-transform:none!important;font-size:12px!important}
#terms .classic-calc{padding:26px!important}
#terms .calc-final strong{font-size:clamp(30px,3vw,42px)!important}

@media(min-width:901px){
  #case .camp-fit-grid.swapped,#explore .explorer{align-items:stretch!important}
}
@media(max-width:900px){
  #case .camp-fit-grid.swapped,#explore .explorer{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
  #case .camp-fit-photo.large-photo img,#explore .task-visual-card img{flex:none!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important;object-fit:contain!important}
  #case .camp-fit-photo.large-photo,#explore .task-visual-card{height:auto!important}

}

/* Conversion-focused revision */
.director-problem{background:#f6f9f2}.director-problem .wrap,.time-cost .wrap,.proof-launch .wrap{max-width:1320px}
.director-problem h2,.time-cost h2,.proof-launch h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,42px);line-height:1.16;max-width:850px;margin:10px 0 25px}
.pain-grid,.proof-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:17px}
.pain-grid article,.proof-grid article{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dbe7d8;border-radius:22px;padding:24px;box-shadow:0 9px 23px rgba(28,51,39,.045)}
.pain-grid h3,.proof-grid h3{font-size:23px;line-height:1.2;margin:8px 0 12px;color:#173e2e}
.pain-grid p,.proof-grid p,.pain-closing,.roi-copy p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;color:#506b59}
.pain-num{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:#138163}.pain-closing{margin-top:23px;max-width:900px;font-weight:600}
.time-cost{background:#fffaf2}.roi-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:30px;align-items:center}.roi-copy h2{margin-bottom:18px}.roi-disclaimer{font-size:13px!important;color:#738476!important}
.roi-card{background:#eaf2e8;border:1px solid #cfded1;padding:28px;border-radius:25px}.roi-inputs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:15px}.roi-inputs label{display:grid;gap:9px;color:#264535;font-size:14px;font-weight:650}.roi-inputs label:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}.roi-inputs input{width:100%;background:white;border:1px solid #cadccd;border-radius:12px;padding:13px 14px;font-size:19px;color:#173f2f;min-width:0}.roi-answer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:17px}.roi-answer>div{padding:16px;background:white;border-radius:15px}.roi-answer span{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#597463;margin-bottom:8px}.roi-answer strong{display:block;font-size:28px;color:#164934}.roi-card>p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#68806e}
.proof-launch{background:#f4f8f2}.proof-grid article span{display:inline-block;margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.03em;color:#147b57;font-weight:700}
.terms-detail{grid-column:1/-1;margin-top:18px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid #d9e5d8}.terms-detail h3{font-size:23px;color:#183d2f;margin:0 0 15px}.terms-detail-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:13px}.terms-detail-grid>div{background:#f2f6ef;border-radius:15px;padding:18px}.terms-detail-grid strong{color:#204534}.terms-detail-grid p{font-size:14px;color:#51695a;line-height:1.55}
#camp .camp-ops-lead{max-width:650px}
@media(max-width:900px){.roi-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.pain-grid,.proof-grid,.terms-detail-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:540px){.roi-inputs,.roi-answer{grid-template-columns:1fr}.roi-inputs label:last-child{grid-column:auto}.roi-card{padding:18px}}

.custom-problem{background:#fffdf7;border:1px solid #dbe6da;border-radius:24px;padding:24px;margin:0 0 28px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}.custom-problem h3{font-size:24px;line-height:1.25;margin:8px 0}.custom-problem p{color:#4e6859;line-height:1.6}.custom-choices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.custom-choices label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid #d7e4d7;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;color:#243d31;font-size:14px;background:white}.custom-summary{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #dae4d8}.roi-compare{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}.roi-compare>div{background:white;border:1px solid #dbe6da;border-radius:14px;padding:14px}.roi-compare small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#5e7465}.roi-compare strong{display:block;font-size:28px;color:#1d3e31;margin-top:8px}.roi-compare .roi-delta{grid-column:1/-1;background:#dceee2}.roi-delta span{display:block;margin-top:6px;color:#536d5c}.roi-footnote{font-size:13px!important;color:#5e7568!important}.decision-steps{margin-top:20px;padding:22px;background:#edf4ec;border-radius:20px}.decision-steps h3{font-size:22px;margin:0 0 12px;color:#18392d}.decision-steps>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px}.decision-steps span{border:1px solid #cfdfce;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;padding:14px;font-size:14px;color:#264435}.roi-copy h2,.proof-launch h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3vw,42px)}@media(max-width:850px){.custom-problem{grid-template-columns:1fr}.decision-steps>div{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}@media(max-width:520px){.custom-choices,.roi-compare,.decision-steps>div{grid-template-columns:1fr}.roi-compare .roi-delta{grid-column:auto}}
/* Real partner camp references */
.real-camps{margin:26px 0 32px}
.real-camps-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:20px;margin-bottom:18px}
.real-camps-top h3{font-size:28px;line-height:1.2;margin:6px 0;color:#213f33}
.camps-source{color:#196b4f;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;white-space:nowrap}
.real-camps-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.real-camp{padding:22px;background:#f8fbf7;border:1px solid #d9e7d9;border-radius:19px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:218px}
.camp-customer{font-size:20px;color:#173f2e;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.2}
.real-camp p{font-size:15px;color:#496456;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 16px}
.camp-person{font-size:12px;color:#657b6e;line-height:1.4;border-top:1px solid #d9e7d9;padding-top:12px;margin-top:auto}
.camps-note{font-size:12px;color:#63776b;line-height:1.5;margin-top:13px}
@media(max-width:1000px){.real-camps-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:600px){.real-camps-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.real-camps-top{align-items:start;flex-direction:column}.real-camp{min-height:0}.camps-source{white-space:normal}}


/* v9: restore simple labor calculator + partners carousel */
.partners-strip{margin:28px 0 26px;padding:28px 30px;border-radius:28px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#173e31 0%,#215640 55%,#2a6a4d 100%);color:#fff;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 18px 34px rgba(19,56,42,.14)}
.partners-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:18px}.partners-top .eyebrow.light{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82)!important}.partners-top h3{font-size:44px;line-height:1.05;color:#fff;margin:0}
.partners-marquee{overflow:hidden;position:relative}.partners-track{display:flex;gap:18px;min-width:max-content;animation:partners-scroll 34s linear infinite}.partner-item{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:230px;padding:22px 26px;border-radius:22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);font-size:24px;line-height:1.2;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
.partners-note{margin:14px 0 0;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
@keyframes partners-scroll{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.partners-marquee:hover .partners-track{animation-play-state:paused}

#time-cost .roi-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:center}

#time-cost .roi-inputs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:18px}#time-cost .roi-inputs label{display:grid;gap:8px;font-size:14px;color:#53695c;font-weight:600}#time-cost .roi-inputs input{width:100%;padding:16px 18px;border:1px solid #cad8ca;border-radius:14px;background:#fff;color:#1f382f;font-size:24px;font-weight:700}
#time-cost .roi-answer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin:8px 0 12px}#time-cost .roi-answer>div{background:#fff;border:1px solid #d9e4d9;border-radius:20px;padding:22px}#time-cost .roi-answer span{display:block;color:#5f7568;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px}#time-cost .roi-answer strong{font-size:38px;line-height:1.08;color:#1e3a30}

/* v11 — meeting-first commercial story */
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}

.transition-compare{margin:22px 0 26px;background:#f8fbf8;border:1px solid #d8e5d9;border-radius:24px;padding:25px;color:#1d3d2e}.transition-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:18px}.transition-head h3{font-size:27px;color:#183e2b;margin:7px 0}.transition-switch{display:flex;gap:6px;background:#e5eee4;padding:5px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap}.transition-btn{background:transparent;border:none;border-radius:999px;color:#204b38;padding:10px 18px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}.transition-btn.current{background:#146548;color:#fff}.transition-steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:14px 0}.transition-steps span{border:1px solid #d7e5d6;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;padding:17px 12px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;color:#294839}.transition-status{font-size:19px;font-weight:750;color:#194b34}.transition-body p{font-size:15px;color:#516b5b}.transition-disclaimer{display:block;color:#708274;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}
